gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns a mismatch in the population latent-consistency residual: the proof uses E(x) where the stated loss requires E(F(x)), so the decomposition does not represent the claimed loss. ISSUE-001 instead concerns an incorrect choice of the deviation parameter delta and the resulting rate extraction from T2 estimates. Although both occur in the proof of Theorem 1 near T2, they are distinct mathematical formulas and failed obligations; the prediction does not recognize the residual-target mismatch or the required F(x) evaluation.
